creed.name: Apostles' Creed
creed.text:
↑ I believe in God, the Father almighty,
↓ Creator of heaven and earth,
↑ and in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord,
↓ who was conceived by the Holy Spirit,
↑ born of the Virgin Mary,
↓ suffered under Pontius Pilate,
↑ was crucified, died and was buried;
↓ he descended into hell;
↑ on the third day he rose again from the dead;
↓ he ascended into heaven,
↑ and is seated at the right hand of God the Father almighty;
↓ from there he will come to judge the living and the dead.

↑ I believe in the Holy Spirit,
↓ the holy catholic Church,
↑ the communion of saints,
↓ the forgiveness of sins,
↑ the resurrection of the body,
↓ and life everlasting.

✦ Amen.

our_father.name: Our Father
our_father.text:
↑ Our Father, who art in heaven,
↓ hallowed be thy name;

↑ thy kingdom come,
↓ thy will be done,
↑ on earth as it is in heaven.

↑ Give us this day our daily bread,
↓ and forgive us our trespasses,
↑ as we forgive those who trespass against us;

↓ and lead us not into temptation,
↑ but deliver us from evil.

✦ Amen.

hail_mary.name: Hail Mary
hail_mary.text:
↑ Hail Mary, full of grace,
↓ the Lord is with thee.
↑ Blessed art thou among women,
↓ and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

↑ Holy Mary, Mother of God,
↓ pray for us sinners,
↑ now and at the hour of our death.

✦ Amen.

glory_be.name: Glory Be
glory_be.text:
↑ Glory be to the Father,
↓ and to the Son,
↑ and to the Holy Spirit;

↓ as it was in the beginning,
↑ is now,
↓ and ever shall be,
↑ world without end.

✦ Amen.

hail_holy_queen.name: Hail Holy Queen
hail_holy_queen.text:
↑ Hail, holy Queen, Mother of mercy,
↓ our life, our sweetness and our hope.

↑ To thee do we cry,
↓ poor banished children of Eve;
↑ to thee do we send up our sighs,
↓ mourning and weeping in this valley of tears.

↑ Turn, then, most gracious advocate,
↓ thine eyes of mercy toward us,
↑ and after this our exile
↓ show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

↑ O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

✦ Amen.

sign_of_cross.name: Sign of the Cross
sign_of_cross.text:
↑ In the name of the Father,
↓ and of the Son,
↑ and of the Holy Spirit.

✦ Amen.

seated_forward_fold.name: Seated Forward Fold
seated_forward_fold.setup: Sit with legs extended. Bend the knees as much as you need. Fold forward from the hips. Let the head and shoulders hang heavy.
seated_forward_fold.hold: A long pull along the back of the legs and the spine. Soft. Never forced.
seated_forward_fold.target: Posterior chain — hamstrings, low back, spine

child_pose.name: Child's Pose
child_pose.setup: Kneel with big toes touching. Knees wide or together. Sink the hips toward the heels. Stretch the arms forward. Forehead rests on the mat.
child_pose.hold: Grounded, sheltered. The spine lengthens, the hips release, the breath slows.

supported_butterfly.name: Supported Butterfly
supported_butterfly.setup: Lie on your back. Soles of the feet together, knees fall open. Place a pillow or folded towel under each knee. Arms rest at the sides, palms up.
supported_butterfly.hold: An opening through the inner thighs and front of the hips. Heavy. Yielding.

banana.name: Reclined Side Stretch
banana.setup: On your back, arms overhead. Walk both feet and the upper body to one side so the body forms a long curve. Both shoulders and hips stay on the floor. Hold one side, then switch.
banana.hold: A long opening down the side of the body — ribs, waist, hip. The pose most sequences skip. Critical for the low back.

savasana.name: Savasana
savasana.setup: Lie flat. Legs fall open naturally. Arms slightly out from the body, palms up. Let everything be where it falls.
savasana.hold: The pause before the mysteries begin. Body held by the ground. Mind held by the breath.

knees_to_chest.name: Knees-to-Chest
knees_to_chest.setup: Lying on your back, draw both knees toward the chest. Hands on the shins or behind the thighs. Breathe.
knees_to_chest.hold: A gentle decompression of the low back. Returns the body to neutral between decades.

neutral_back.name: Neutral on Back
neutral_back.setup: Lie flat, legs extended, hands resting on the belly so you can feel the breath rise and fall.
neutral_back.hold: One minute. The Glory Be. Then the next mystery is announced.

figure_four.name: Reclined Figure-Four
figure_four.setup: Lie on the back. Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh. Draw the bottom thigh toward the chest, threading the hands behind it (or use a towel as a strap). Hold five Hail Marys per side.
figure_four.hold: A deep release through the outer hip and glute. The body's most common source of low-back stiffness lives here.

supported_bridge.name: Supported Bridge
supported_bridge.setup: Lie on the back, knees bent, feet flat. Lift the hips and slide a low block or folded towel under the sacrum — the bony plate above the tailbone, not the lower back. Use the lowest prop height that supports you. If you feel a pinch in the low back, slide the prop down toward the tailbone or remove it entirely.
supported_bridge.hold: An unwinding of the hip flexors. A quiet opening across the chest. The whole front body softens.

happy_baby.name: Happy Baby
happy_baby.setup: Lying on the back, draw the knees toward the chest. Grab the outside edges of the feet (or the shins, or behind the knees). Stack ankles over knees. Gently pull the knees toward the armpits.
happy_baby.hold: A childlike decompression of the lower back. A wide opening through the hips. Release the grip whenever it tires — the pose is the position, not the grip.

supported_fish.name: Supported Fish
supported_fish.setup: Place a folded blanket or low block lengthwise along the spine — short edge at the bottom tip of the shoulder blades. Lie back over it. Head rests on the floor or on a second, lower prop. Legs long, arms open. Keep the prop low — the neck should not strain.
supported_fish.hold: A passive opening across the chest and front of the shoulders. The upper back gently arches. If the low back grumbles, the prop is too low — move it higher.

legs_up_wall.name: Legs Up the Wall
legs_up_wall.setup: Sit close to a wall, hip touching it. Swing the legs up as you lower the back to the floor. The body forms an L. Hips flat or supported on a folded blanket. Arms open.
legs_up_wall.hold: The legs flush. The heart rate drops. The nervous system shifts toward sleep. The closing hold.

breath.name: Ujjayi
breath.description: Oceanic breath. Slow, full, audible at the back of the throat. Expansive. The throat is awake.

items.name: The Annunciation
items.reflection: Gabriel appears to Mary. The Word is offered.

items.name: The Visitation
items.reflection: Mary visits Elizabeth. The unborn John leaps in recognition.

items.name: The Nativity
items.reflection: Christ is born in Bethlehem. The world meets him as an infant.

items.name: The Presentation
items.reflection: The infant Christ is presented in the temple. Simeon prophesies.

items.name: The Finding in the Temple
items.reflection: The boy Christ, lost three days, is found teaching.

breath.name: Long exhale
breath.description: Short inhale through the nose. Long, slow exhale through the mouth. The breath receives. Lord, into Thy hands.

items.name: The Agony in the Garden
items.reflection: Christ prays in Gethsemane. The cup will not pass.

items.name: The Scourging at the Pillar
items.reflection: Pilate orders the scourging. The body is broken before the cross.

items.name: The Crowning with Thorns
items.reflection: The soldiers mock him. The crown of suffering is given.

items.name: The Carrying of the Cross
items.reflection: Christ bears the cross to Calvary. Simon helps. Veronica wipes his face.

items.name: The Crucifixion
items.reflection: Christ dies on the cross. The veil of the temple is torn.

breath.name: Victorious breath
breath.description: Full, deep inhale that opens the chest. Slow release. The breath of resurrection.

items.name: The Resurrection
items.reflection: Christ rises on the third day. The stone is rolled away.

items.name: The Ascension
items.reflection: Christ ascends to the Father.

items.name: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
items.reflection: Pentecost. The Spirit comes upon the apostles.

items.name: The Assumption
items.reflection: Mary is taken body and soul into heaven.

items.name: The Coronation of Mary
items.reflection: Mary is crowned Queen of Heaven.

breath.name: Nadi Shodhana
breath.description: Alternate-nostril breath. Inhale left, exhale right; inhale right, exhale left. Light entering both sides of the mind.

items.name: The Baptism of Jesus
items.reflection: In the Jordan. The Spirit descends as a dove.

items.name: The Wedding at Cana
items.reflection: Water becomes wine. The first sign.

items.name: The Proclamation of the Kingdom
items.reflection: Repent and believe the good news.

items.name: The Transfiguration
items.reflection: On the mountain. Christ shines.

items.name: The Institution of the Eucharist
items.reflection: At the Last Supper. Take and eat.

easy.name: Easy
easy.description: Body feels neutral or open tonight.

tender.name: Tender
tender.description: Some stiffness or mild ache. Soften the practice.

hurt.name: Hurt
hurt.description: Sharp or persistent pain. Replace the risky holds.

pendant.name: The Pendant
pendant.description: Seven onboarding weeks. The body learns the protocol. The Threshold trial closes the pendant.

closing.name: The Closing
closing.description: One quiet week. The year is handed back.

joyful.name: Joyful
joyful.summary: Open the body. The breath sets the pace.

sorrowful.name: Sorrowful
sorrowful.summary: Long, slow, continuous. The body learns the hour.

intro.summary: 30 min easy run or brisk walk

luminous.name: Luminous
luminous.summary: Movement quality. Position is the proof.

sanctum.name: Sanctum
sanctum.summary: No work today. Review the bead. Write the Sanctum note. Close.

RELAY.name: RELAY
RELAY.character: The handler. Calm, unflappable. Served Mary first.

THE QUARTERMASTER.name: THE QUARTERMASTER
THE QUARTERMASTER.character: Career NCO. Believes the body is equipment and equipment is maintained.

CHAPLAIN.name: CHAPLAIN
CHAPLAIN.character: Soft-voiced, ecumenical. The room quiets to hear her.

THE METRONOME.name: THE METRONOME
THE METRONOME.character: Speaks in numbers and split times. Pace is a moral quality.

LONGWATCH.name: LONGWATCH
LONGWATCH.character: The sentry. Liturgical without being pious. Slightly haunted.

THE RAVEN.name: THE RAVEN
THE RAVEN.character: The internal contrarian. Speaks once per day at most.

RELAY.build: Operator. {time}. {decade_name}, bead {bead}. Build. {modality}. Stay on the protocol.
RELAY.deload: Operator. {time}. {decade_name}, bead {bead}. Deload. The Rosary breathes this week.
RELAY.taper: Operator. {time}. {decade_name}, bead {bead}. Taper. The {boss_short} is open at bead ten.
RELAY.boss: Operator. {time}. Bead ten. The {boss_short} is open. Pre-fight protocol active.
RELAY.trial: Operator. {time}. The Threshold trial. The line is the practice.
RELAY.pendant: Operator. {time}. Pendant, bead {bead}. The body learns the protocol.
RELAY.closing: Operator. {time}. The Return. The year is yours.

THE QUARTERMASTER.joyful: The body opens in order. Shoulders first. Hips next.
THE QUARTERMASTER.sorrowful: Cadence is the work. Don't bank time.
THE QUARTERMASTER.luminous: Three attempts. Don't grind. Position arrives or it doesn't.
THE QUARTERMASTER.deload: Today the kit stays in the locker. Two-thirds is the whole prescription.
THE QUARTERMASTER.boss: Save the work. The {boss_short} has the rest.

CHAPLAIN.joyful: In through the nose. The body has already started. {prescription_short}.
CHAPLAIN.sorrowful: The exhale is where each step finishes.
CHAPLAIN.glorious: The breath holds the rep together. Don't lose it under load.
CHAPLAIN.luminous: Slow. The position is the work, not the count.
CHAPLAIN.sanctum: No work. Logbook, breath, and the next bead's preview.
CHAPLAIN.deload: The body is recovering from work it already did. Let it.

THE METRONOME.joyful: Set the breath to a four-count. Hold it.
THE METRONOME.glorious: Tempo on the eccentric. Three seconds down.

LONGWATCH.vigil: The hour holds. Step into it.
LONGWATCH.sanctum: The week is held. Review it before you close it.
LONGWATCH.boss: Sleep is part of the fight. Begin counting it now.

THE RAVEN.missed: no makeup work. take today as written.
THE RAVEN.vigil: the body is asking for water first.

the_threshold.name: OF₂ — The Threshold
the_threshold.mystery_anchor: Centerpiece / Mary. The first step over the line.
the_threshold.first_contact: Operator. Bead six. The Threshold opens this week. This is not a fight. It is a measurement — the line every future engagement is drawn from. Do the work honestly. Under-perform and Year One starts under-counted. Over-perform and you'll spend a year chasing a ghost. Set the line where the body actually lives. Then step across it.
protocol: Pushups to fatigue.
Situps to fatigue.
Plank to fatigue.
Half-mile walk-or-run at honest pace.
the_threshold.scoring: Each number recorded. No grade. The line is the baseline.

the_anvil.name: The Anvil
the_anvil.mystery_anchor: The Nativity. The body forged on the floor.
the_anvil.first_contact: Operator. Bead ten. The Forge is open. The Anvil holds the position at the next compatible workout of your choosing — within six weeks. Strength-endurance, no run. Floor, wall, doorway. The fight is the fight. Pre-fight protocol begins twenty-four hours before contact: light meal, full sleep, no caffeine after 1400. Make the connection.
protocol: Pushups to fatigue.
Pullup progression to fatigue (dead-hang time + negatives at progression value).
Situps to fatigue.
Plank to fatigue.
the_anvil.scoring: (PU + SU) + (Pullup-equiv × 2) + plank seconds. Graded against AF bracket.

the_long_garden.name: The Long Garden
the_long_garden.mystery_anchor: The Agony. The hour that will not end.
the_long_garden.first_contact: Operator. Bead ten. The Garden has opened. The fight is not heavy. It is long. One hour, the same minute repeating, the body keeping its appointment with itself. The Garden is where the cup is offered and not refused. You will want to stop at minute thirty-two. Stop instead at minute sixty. Pre-fight protocol begins now.
protocol: One hour, EMOM: 10 pushups + 10 situps, then wall-sit to next minute.
Every ten minutes: 30-second plank, then resume.
the_long_garden.scoring: Total minutes completed at prescription. Sixty is standard. Forty is honest. Twenty is data.

the_rising.name: The Rising
the_rising.mystery_anchor: The Resurrection. The stone moved by the body alone.
the_rising.first_contact: Operator. Bead ten. The Rising. The first fight Year One has asked you to be strong for — not enduring, not patient. Strong. Five rounds, full rest, every rep honest. The stone is not heavy. The stone is exact. Lift it once, correctly, five times. Pre-fight protocol begins twenty-four hours before contact.
protocol: Five rounds, full rest (3–5 min) between rounds:
Pullup progression — max quality reps at hardest available step.
Pistol-squat progression — max quality reps per side.
Archer or one-arm-assist pushup — max quality reps per side.
Hollow-body hold to break.
the_rising.scoring: Sum of progression-weighted reps + total hollow seconds. Graded against operator's pre-decade test.

the_shining.name: The Shining
the_shining.mystery_anchor: The Transfiguration. The body changed by being looked at.
the_shining.first_contact: Operator. Bead ten. The Mountain. This fight does not reward effort. It rewards attention. Eight stations, each one a position the body either holds or doesn't. There is no grinding past a missed station — you re-attempt, and either the position arrives or it doesn't. Spend the week before in the Vigil and in mobility. Pre-fight protocol is slow, not heavy.
protocol: Eight stations, three attempts each, best counted:
Full pistol L/R; 3s L-sit on the floor; Crow to break; Wall handstand to break; Deep squat 3 min unsupported; Forward fold palms flat; Bridge full extension 30s; Hollow-to-arch roll.
the_shining.scoring: Stations passed at standard. Form is the score.

the_crown.name: The Crown
the_crown.mystery_anchor: The Coronation. The year placed on the head.
the_crown.first_contact: Operator. Bead ten of the fifth decade. The Crown. The protocol asks for everything Year One taught the body, in one sitting, in canonical order. The roll at the end is not theatre — it is the year asking which fight it is fondest of. Pre-fight protocol begins forty-eight hours before contact. Sleep is part of the fight.
protocol: Full AF PT test in canonical order: pushups (1 min), situps (1 min), plank (max), 1.5-mile run.
Parliament roll: d6 selects a previous boss's signature stress, performed once after the run.
the_crown.scoring: AF grade across all four components, plus pass/fail on the Parliament-roll station.

the_return.name: The Return
the_return.mystery_anchor: Hail Holy Queen. The year handed back.
the_return.first_contact: Operator. Bead fifty-eight. The Return. There is no engagement at this bead — only a long quiet day, the protocol walked at its own pace, and the year's entry written in your own hand. Year Two opens at the next bead-cycle. The Rosary does not end here. It begins again, walked by the operator the Rosary made.
protocol: Full Vigil at canonical pace.
One hour of unbroken movement at conversational effort.
Full nightly practice at day's end.
Codex closing entry, written by hand.
the_return.scoring: No score. The session is the entry.

measure_honestly.text: Measure honestly; the line is the practice.

the_hour_will_not_be_shortened.text: The hour will not be shortened.

lift_once_correctly.text: Lift once, correctly, before lifting again.

everything_in_order.text: Everything I was taught, in order, on the day.

i_walked_it.text: I am the one who walked it.
